script:
I stood on the scale in my kitchen, and the number was back. Same jeans, same mirror, and I felt like I had failed at the one thing I promised myself I would never do again.

Then that week I learned it was not willpower. A study followed people for a full year after their diet, and the hunger was still louder, the fullness signal still weaker. My body was not betraying me, it was protecting me.

So I started again, smaller this time. Protein at breakfast, a walk after dinner, the measuring cup back on the counter. Three months later the jeans fit again, and this time I knew why it would hold. Save this for the day you want to quit.
